ThingDef.label: pick-up point shelf
ThingDef.description: A shelf used as a designated pick-up point in the local colony logistical network. Instructions Crafters can grab items from your stockpile as long as your stockpile has shelves with a storage designation signpost. Crafters will only grab items which are within the ingredient radius you've set on their crafting stations (defaults to be unlimited). FAQ How is this logistics solution performance wis- HEY!? Why is my question COLOURED? Is this VIBE CODED!? ARE YOU PATCHING Thing.DoTick()?" No need to be alarmed strawperson! The mod is fully written by non-mechanical lifeforms and should improve performance; Less expensive long-distance pathfinding updates etc. Language models seem to horribly abuse text colour and sensibly decided... I needed to prove I can abuse it even worse. You're welcome!

ThingDef.label: storage designation
ThingDef.description: A sign-post designating storage facilities nearby to be administered by the colony's logistical network. Instructions Adds any items on shelves in range to the logistic system so they can be retrieved at pick-up points. This lets items be picked up by crafters to use on most standard crafting station near a pickup point. "Okay, but how is it getting to the pick-up point?" Well, you see your bartender knew he needed about 10 fruits for his customers on an average Tuesday and simply planned ahead. "The pick-up point is empty though." No it isn't. "I literally saw half a stack of potatoes vanish from storage and appear magically appear on the shelf when my cook was working. Is this a magic mod?" Not at all this is just mundane everyday logistics mod. Your colonists are planning ahead. "I can see items teleporting!" You're just imagining things. This is a perfectly mundane sign post. You craft it from mundane materials like wood, stone, D-38, and steel. "Am I being gaslighted by dantian-destroying damned mod authors now?" It is probably Oscar's fault somehow. Blame him. Take your justified vengeance by sending him error reports logs for his 'VE Outposts - Mechanoid Pregnancy+' mod with like 200 anime mods! That'll show the smug bastard! "You're damn right I will!
